annotations.title: FHA and conforming loan limits for a county

description: The current-year FHA forward and FHFA conforming loan limits for 1, 2, 3 and 4 units in one county (or parish, borough, planning region, municipio), whether FHA treats it as high-cost, the 1-unit conforming figure VA uses with entitlement in use, and the highest price that keeps an FHA base loan inside the limit at 3.5% down.

county.description: County or equivalent name, e.g. "Los Angeles" or "Kent County".

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code, e.g. CA, DC or PR.
